person_note: The quote set repeatedly shows a nonparticipating narrator naming Nina, June, Kit, Hud, Mick, and others while reporting their private thoughts and shifting among characters. First- and second-person forms occur in dialogue, unattributed fragments, aphorisms, or generic/free-indirect formulations, not autonomous base-narration sections. Authorized excerpts establish the same third-person mode in both the 1983 storyline and the historical June-and-Mick storyline, while whole-book sources explicitly describe third-person narration moving among consciousnesses. The remaining uncertainty is only that the authorized excerpts do not reproduce every chapter; the broad quote coverage and whole-book descriptions resolve that limitation.
